lines.line: Who lives longest in the Middle East?
Sixty years of World Bank data. Eleven countries.
Israel starts on top, at seventy two years. Lebanon is next.
Nineteen seventy five. Civil war in Lebanon. It drops eight years.
Two thousand five. The UAE overtakes Israel.
Syria's civil war costs ten years.
Then the pandemic hits the Gulf.
Twenty twenty three. The Palestinian territories drop eleven years, the year the war began.
The runner up ends less than half a year behind. The third, less than one.
If you like Israel facts, follow <<n|oʊ|ˈ|ɑ|m>> <<ˈ|r|ɑː|z>> for more.
And the top of the table?
Israel. Eighty three point two years.
